lead: Balances, receivables, transactions, and renewal policies always come from current backend facts. Currencies remain separate without hidden conversion.

creditPayment.title: Confirm credit payment
creditPayment.description: This payment is {amount}. Estimated available credit afterward is {remaining}. The server checks the limit again before settling.
creditPayment.success: Credit payment completed and the order is financially settled.
creditPayment.failed: Credit payment did not complete. The invoice and limit remain unchanged.

recharge.title: Add account balance
recharge.description: Choose a currency and a payment channel enabled by this merchant. Confirmed funds are credited to the matching balance.
recharge.invalid: Enter a positive amount and choose a payment channel and method.
recharge.failed: Recharge could not be started. Check the payment channel and try again.
recharge.confirmationNote: Returning from the cashier does not credit funds. Balance changes only after the payment platform confirms success.
recharge.scanDescription: Scan this code in WeChat. After payment, select “Check credit status” to read the server-confirmed result.
recharge.unavailable: No payment channel has passed the capability gate, so recharge is unavailable. Existing balance payments still work.

paymentReturn.title: Payment confirmation
paymentReturn.description: This page shows the server-confirmed result. Returning from a cashier never credits the balance by itself.
paymentReturn.loadFailed: Payment status is temporarily unavailable. Try refreshing shortly.

merge.title: Merge these invoices?
merge.description: Only untouched invoices for the same customer and currency are merged. Source invoices remain immutable evidence.

balancePayment.title: Confirm balance payment
balancePayment.description: Use the available balance in the same currency? The server charges the exact current outstanding amount.

renewal.note: Automatic renewal only uses same-currency available balance. Insufficient funds never create a false success.
renewal.insufficient: Automatic renewal could not finish because the balance is insufficient. The current policy retries after funds are added.

messages.loadFailed: Financial data is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
messages.merged: Invoices were merged safely and the list was refreshed.
messages.paid: Balance payment succeeded and invoice facts were refreshed.
